elements in the urine are detected using dry 
reagent strips called dipsticks. 
•Dipping  the test strip into urine →  activation

specific color chang

•Comparing this color change against a 
reference color chart provided by the 
supplier→ indicate the presence (-,+,++,+++) or 
absence of the tested element.
